w.name: Pick A Card

description.normalized: First Cast: Start Shuffling Twisted Fate's Deck. Second Cast: Pick a card to empower his next attack. Red Cards deal 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 (+60% AP +100% AD) magic damage in an area and slow by 35% / 40% / 45% / 50% for 3 seconds. Blue Cards deal 40 / 65 / 90 / 115 (+75% AP +100% AD) magic damage and restore 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 Mana. Gold Cards deal 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 (+50% AP +100% AD) magic damage and stun for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds.
